name: unilytics
description: Your saved SEO, content and AEO playbooks, client context and research tools, in Claude.
long_description: Unilytics holds your saved skills (your own step-by-step playbooks for SEO, content, AEO/GEO and client work), each client's Brand Kit, Context and Knowledge Base, and the research tools those skills use. This extension connects Claude to your Unilytics account. All tools run on Unilytics' servers; some use credits from your account.

api_key.title: Unilytics API key
api_key.description: Starts with ulk_live_. Create one in the Unilytics app: Settings → API Keys (https://app.unilytics.ai/settings/api-keys).

tools.name: find_skill
tools.description: Find the best of your saved skills for a task

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Read a skill's playbook and files

tools.name: get_project_context
tools.description: Read a client's Brand Kit and Context

tools.name: keyword_research
tools.description: Search volume, CPC and competition for keywords

tools.name: serp_results
tools.description: Current Google results for a keyword

tools.name: site_crawl
tools.description: Crawl a website for pages and technical issues
